add.tooltipAea: The School Food Authority of the Department of Education will provide food, cleaning materials, menus, training for food service staff, gas and fumigation service, among other things. The entity must provide food service employees and the necessary cafeteria facilities with all minimum required equipment.
add.tooltipDe: The applying entity will be responsible for the administration of the Food Services Program. The Department of Education will reimburse the participating entity an amount of money for each meal served to qualifying students. With this reimbursement the entity will purchase fresh, frozen and canned food to be used, pay food service employees and purchase equipment for the same.
